title: The GPS said turn right
what: The black SUV follows the GPS's 'Turn Right' (163 ft to 0 ft on screen) straight into a silver car at the intersection; the crash camera, then the other driver gets out: 'Hey yo! What the f, man? My f-ing ride, bruh! Damn!'
why: letterbox: the turn and the crash move sideways and the GPS box is in the corner; no edit: the reaction line is the second laugh; this version has the optional wrong-mood music bed on (20 dB under the game while a line is heard, 12 dB under it between lines)
